seo.title: Factors of 36 Speed Grid - Square Number Factors Challenge
seo.metaDescription: Click all 9 factors of 36 on an interactive 10x10 math grid. Test factor pairs and square number divisibility before time expires.
seo.intro: Thirty-six is both a square number (6 x 6) and a highly composite number with 9 factors: 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 9, 12, 18, and 36. Its factor pairs are (1, 36), (2, 18), (3, 12), (4, 9), and the square pair (6, 6). Navigating the 100-number board to find all 9 factors develops multi-step divisibility checks and algebraic number sense.
seo.howToPlay: Find and click all 9 factors of 36. Correct clicks lock green with checkmarks. Incorrect tiles flash red and penalize 2 seconds from the clock. Find all 9 factors to complete the round.
seo.teacherNotes: Draw a factor rainbow on the board connecting pairs: 1 to 36, 2 to 18, 3 to 12, 4 to 9, with 6 resting in the center paired with itself.

faq.q: Why does 36 have an odd number of factors?
faq.a: Like all perfect square numbers, 36 has an odd number of divisors because 6 x 6 produces 36 without a unique partner.
